data.name: Phaetusa

weaponImprint.name: Cause and Effect
weaponImprint.trait: AoE damage dealt is increased by 5%. When dealing AoE Corrosion damage, the AoE damage dealt is further increased by 5%.

data.effects:
Gentle and tolerant, like a spring breeze on the face; sharp and haughty, like cold steel. The former is named Phaetusa, the latter is named Scavenger. This Doll of two hearts in one body—one half originates from the most beautiful guardianship of human civilization, the other side comes from the war wreckage of Sangvis Ferri.
They met amidst the flames of war, saved each other, and decided to forge their own path together in this turbulent era.

level1.description: Selects one target within 1 tile and deals melee Physical damage equal to 80% of attack to it.

For each instance of melee damage dealt, gains 1 point of Confectance Index. This effect can trigger up to 3 times per turn.

When an enemy within range takes an AoE attack from an alled unit, Phaetusa performs [effect:ab2e634f-d257-44e3-af90-ce66a6ac43f3] against that enemy unit 1 time, dealing AoE melee Corrosion damage equal to 90% of attack and 1 point of stability damage. This effect can trigger up to 3 times per turn.

After using the active skill [dollSkill:086f5f38-b5a9-41bb-97c7-b9ce4f1c1bdd], Phaetusa can use [dollSkill:ecd2cfb3-03d9-4ad9-9c6f-58b3346bc56e]. After using [dollSkill:ecd2cfb3-03d9-4ad9-9c6f-58b3346bc56e], she gains [effect:e6969c33-8cec-4590-9a7d-9b3049ca93e3] and [effect:c1feeb2a-d9a9-4a73-9703-8806ee8cb9eb]. This effect can trigger up to 1 time per battle.

level1.description:
Deals AoE Corrosion damage equal to 90% of attack to all enemy targets within 5 tiles.

Consumes all stacks of [effect:805f64bb-a005-4b27-a500-405af4cce3e6], and for each stack consumed, the damage multiplier is increased by 10%, and the total is multiplied by (1 + number of stacks consumed).

TL Note: Regarding “the total is multiplied dealt by (1 + number of stacks consumed)”, this effect multiplies the total damage after all other multipliers. For example, by consuming 3 stacks of [effect:805f64bb-a005-4b27-a500-405af4cce3e6], total damage multiplier becomes [90% + (3 x 10%)] x (1 + 3) = 480% .

level2.description:

Consumes all stacks of [effect:805f64bb-a005-4b27-a500-405af4cce3e6], and for each stack consumed, the damage multiplier is increased by 20%, and the total is multiplied by (1 + number of stacks consumed).

TL Note: Regarding “the total is multiplied dealt by (1 + number of stacks consumed)”, this effect multiplies the total damage after all other multipliers. For example, by consuming 3 stacks of [effect:805f64bb-a005-4b27-a500-405af4cce3e6], total damage multiplier becomes [120% + (3 x 20%)] x (1 + 3) = 720% .

dollEffects.effectDetails: Consumes 1 stack of this effect to increase damage multiplier. Stacks up to 3 times. Cannot be cleansed.
The damage multiplier of the next active skill is increased by 200%. Cannot be cleansed.
At the end of the action, Phaetusa reverts to her state when she gained that effect (including all stat values, effect stacks, and effect remaining durations). Cannot be cleansed.
Performs a Support Attack; cannot be triggered by another Support Attack.
Commands other than movement can be executed.
When taking damage, if the attacker used a blade, take an additional instance of damage equal to 40% of the original damage. Considered a debuff, cannot be cleansed.
Can move once, but cannot use any other commands.
